# The Brand Advertising

> The Brand Advertising (TBA) is an India-focused advertising and brand activation company. Its website explains vehicle branding, retail branding and on-ground campaign formats, shows documented campaign work, and provides a way to request a scoped campaign plan.

Official website: https://thebrandadvertising.com/
Also known as: TBA; TheBrandAdvertising.
Founder: Dimcy Aggarwal. The company About page identifies her and links to her personal LinkedIn profile.

Campaign formats and market availability depend on the requested location, dates, permissions and approved scope. The website does not publish fixed prices or guaranteed campaign results. Use the linked pages for current details.

## Company and planning

- [Home](https://thebrandadvertising.com/): Company overview and routes to advertising services, campaign work and enquiries.
- [About The Brand Advertising](https://thebrandadvertising.com/about): Company introduction, approach and founder Dimcy Aggarwal.
- [Advertising services](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services): Overview of vehicle branding, retail visibility and on-ground activation formats.
- [Pan-India campaign coverage](https://thebrandadvertising.com/pan-india-coverage): How multi-market briefs are planned; local format and execution availability must be confirmed.

## Service guides

- [Auto hood branding](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services/auto-hood-branding): Advertising on the passenger-canopy fabric of auto-rickshaws, with planning guidance for Delhi NCR and other requested markets.
- [Cab branding](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services/cab-branding): Taxi advertising formats, fleet and market planning, production considerations and quotation inputs.
- [Vehicle branding](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services/vehicle-branding): Comparison of auto, cab, bus and van branding formats, subject to market availability.
- [Retail branding](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services/retail-branding): Storefront, in-store and point-of-sale branding, including multi-outlet planning considerations.
- [BTL activation](https://thebrandadvertising.com/services/btl-activation): On-ground formats such as product sampling, mall promotions and roadshows.

## Evidence and contact

- [Campaign work](https://thebrandadvertising.com/campaigns): Documented advertising and brand activation projects shown on the website.
- [Contact TBA](https://thebrandadvertising.com/contact): Enquiry form for target markets, audience, dates and campaign format. Public email: admin@thebrandadvertising.in.
